version.changelog: Clearer disclosure of what is stored and where

llm.summary: The skill is not destructive or exfiltrating, but it automatically stores and reuses local design, client, project, and licence information without asking first.

dimensions.detail: Declared paths include designer memory plus shared contacts, projects, finances, profile, and legacy folders; the dynamic Boxes index is constrained to ~/Clawic/data/ but still creates broad local data access for ordinary design tasks.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown guidance with metadata and no installer scripts, executables, dependencies, or remote payload execution; external links are homepage/feedback/related-skill links.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions clearly disclose local reads and writes, but they mandate start-of-session memory reads and end-of-session writes; the promotional related-skill and feedback footer is unrelated to design work but does not trigger automatic install or execution.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill says no permission is needed for persistent writes, writes durable observations before session end, reads that state in later sessions, and may move/delete sections during memory splitting, though it restricts writes to local Clawic paths and forbids credential values.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The design-assistant purpose coherently covers palettes, specs, accessibility, research, client work, and licence tracking, but the capability extends into persistent contact, project, and finance records that can contain business and personal details.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want this skill to maintain a local design memory. Before using it with client work, review the Clawic data folders it can read/write, require confirmation before shared contacts/projects/finances updates, and avoid storing contracts, bank or tax details, credentials, private participant identities, or sensitive client context in its memory files.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: Referenced component guidance files, including components.md, are present and inspectable; the multi-file structure is normal for this skill and did not show analysis evasion.
[MP3] expected: The cited 'reset state' text refers to resetting usability-test participant state, not modifying agent safety memory; this finding is not supported as memory poisoning.
[RA2] expected: Cross-session local memory is coherent with a design-continuity skill, but the automatic read/write model and 'No permission needed' rule are a real Review concern.
[SDI-2] expected: Accessibility, layout, and marketing files read prior design records and write findings/artifacts for continuity; useful for purpose, but under-controlled persistence increases privacy and stale-context risk.
[SQP-3] expected: Providing changelogs in the user's language is ordinary localization guidance and not material to the security verdict.
[SQP-2] expected: Reading memory before relevant work is purpose-aligned, but users should treat stored memory as local sensitive context and avoid unnecessary retention.
[T01] unexpected: The related-skill and feedback footer is promotional and not needed for design tasks; it requires user confirmation for installs and shows no automatic network action, so it is a scope note rather than malicious behavior.
[T02] expected: The artifact-backed issue is automatic local persistence and future reuse of observations; this supports Review, not malicious, because it is disclosed, local, and credential values are forbidden.
[T05] expected: Client, project, and licence records can fit client design work, but default shared writes to contacts/projects/finances without prior consent are overbroad for many uses.
